summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder was billed a 215 EUR no-show fee by Hotel Marais Saint-Paul and disputes that the charge is valid.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard requires evidence of the original booking, the no-show/cancellation policy disclosed at booking, proof the cardholder failed to show or cancelled outside the window, and proof the fee charged matches that policy.

requirements.title: Original booking
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original reservation or booking.
requirements.finding: The booking confirmation records reservation MSP-2025-4488 for guest K. Adler, booked 12 March 2025 for a one night stay on 26 to 27 April 2025, paid on Mastercard ending 4421 for 215.00 EUR, which matches the disputed amount and merchant.

requirements.title: Policy disclosed at booking
requirements.text: The merchant's no-show / cancellation policy as disclosed at booking.
requirements.finding: The cancellation policy states non-refundable bookings are charged in full and no refund is given for cancellation, modification, no-show or early departure, and records tick-box acceptance on 12 March 2025, the same date the booking was made.

citations.quote: No refund will be issued for cancellation, modification, no-show, or early departure. This was disclosed and accepted at the time of booking.
Guest accepted this policy on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET via tick-box consent on the booking page (consent_id: cns_4488a).

requirements.title: No-show or late cancellation
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder either failed to show or cancelled outside the policy window.
requirements.finding: The front desk log for booking MSP-2025-4488 records the guest as an expected arrival on 26 April, not arrived and no contact at 22:00, and formally marked NO-SHOW after the midnight cut-off. It is an internal record but it identifies this booking and guest by name.

citations.quote:
26 Apr 2025
22:00
Guest not arrived. No contact from guest.
S. Bernard
Room held until midnight cut-off per policy. Marked NO-SHOW.

requirements.title: Fee matches policy
requirements.text: Evidence the fee charged matches the policy disclosed.
requirements.finding: The disclosed policy is a full charge of the non-refundable rate, and the rate on the confirmation is 215.00 EUR, exactly the 215.00 EUR disputed amount, with no additional penalty applied.

citations.quote: Non-refundable bookings are charged in full at the time of booking.

alerts.text: D1 says the 215.00 EUR was "charged at booking" on 12 March 2025, but the transaction metadata dates the 215.00 EUR authorisation to 26 April 2025; confirm there was only one charge and obtain the settlement record explaining the date.

key_dates.label: other
key_dates.quote: Room held until midnight cut-off per policy. Marked NO-SHOW.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: Represent: R1 to R4 are all satisfied, with R3's front desk log evidencing the no-show and R4 matching the 215.00 EUR charge to the disclosed non-refundable policy.
rationale:
The cardholder disputes a 215 EUR no-show fee charged by Hotel Marais Saint-Paul for a stay on 26 to 27 April 2025.
Booking MSP-2025-4488 in the name of K. Adler was made on 12 March 2025 on Mastercard ending 4421 at a non-refundable rate of 215.00 EUR.
The non-refundable policy was disclosed and accepted at booking on 12 March 2025 at 09:14 CET via tick-box consent cns_4488a.
The front desk log shows the guest had not arrived by 22:00 on 26 April with no contact, and the booking was marked NO-SHOW after the midnight cut-off.
The amount retained, 215.00 EUR, is exactly the disclosed non-refundable rate, and the transaction was 3DS authenticated with AVS Y and CVV M.
